lines.en: I test the bowstring as I walk.
I walk the grass, hoofprints shallow.
Wet soil cakes on my horseshoes.
I walk the treeline's edge.

lines.zh: 我的马蹄，在湿地上打滑。
lines.en: My hooves slip on wet ground.
Savanna-born, my four hooves stay steady.

lines.zh: 我从早走到晚，还没到头。
lines.en: I've walked from dawn to dusk and not reached the end.
This grass is too tall; it blocks my sight.
The shoulders on my back are stiff.
Four hooves, faster than you.
Light hooves, long shots. Do not come closer.
I step around the fallen log without stopping.

lines.zh: 我听草丛里有没有动静。
lines.en: I listen for movement in the grass.
Standing on four legs steadies my bow.
claws fell off again.
My hooves strike and the ground shakes.
I lower my head and crop the grass.

lines.zh: 草原安静得不对劲，弓弦响了。
lines.en: The plain is too quiet; my bowstring sounds.
My ears swivel left.
That bow still rides on my back.

lines.zh: 我把弓挂在身侧，歇一会。
lines.en: I hang the bow at my side and rest.
I'll stand right here and not shift.
Poison on my arrowhead.
Centaur? Doesn't look like one.

lines.zh: 我的箭头上，抹着毒和虚弱。
lines.en: My arrowheads carry poison and weakness.
Your eyes are on my quiver.

lines.zh: 马蹄印到这儿就是界线。
lines.en: The hoofprints mark the line.
Your bow is a hand shorter than mine.

lines.zh: 草原上就你一个人在走。
lines.en: You're the only one walking this plain.

lines.zh: 你这身铁，敲起来声音不错。
lines.en: This iron of yours has a nice ring.
The sound of hooves and I draw my bow.

lines.zh: 我的人肩和马的背，都绷着。
lines.en: Both my shoulders and my horse back are taut.
Four hooves still stand, but my body drags.
This arrow is poisoned. You can't dodge it.

lines.zh: 马腿撑着，还能再站一会。
lines.en: Horse legs braced — I can stand a while.
My arrowhead trembles.
My four hooves won't hold.

lines.zh: 我一跑开，伤口就合上了。
lines.en: I run off and the wound closes.

lines.zh: 我人腿的伤口，血往下淌。
lines.en: Blood runs down my human leg.
Horse body's fine. The human bones cracked.
Do not make me strike back.
A hit lands on my horse flank.

lines.zh: 我咽了口口水，弓没放下。
lines.en: I swallow, bow still up.

lines.zh: 你包里的东西，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell what's in your pack.
Just toss that meat over.
Sweet things are rare on the plain.
My arrows carry weakness.

lines.zh: 那袋肉干的味道，飘得很远。
lines.en: That jerky smell carries a long way.

lines.zh: 你的马，比你的食物更香。
lines.en: Your horse smells better than your food.
Even your leftovers will do.
My arrows carry poison and weakness.

lines.zh: 我射箭时，蹄子先踏两下。
lines.en: Before I shoot, my hooves stamp twice.

lines.zh: 我侧过马身，让开一条路。
lines.en: I turn my horse body aside to let you pass.
The hit buckles my forelegs.
My hooves met you — say something.

lines.zh: 我的胸口和你的肩顶住了。
lines.en: My chest and your shoulder lock.

lines.zh: 你撞我，我的箭袋晃了一下。
lines.en: You hit me and my quiver rattles.
This horsehide is like a wall.
You knocked the bow on my back askew.
My hind hoof slips half an inch.

lines.zh: 我们的蹄子差点绊在一起。
lines.en: Our hooves nearly tangled.
Both the human leg and the horse legs go numb.
I block the wind from the treeline for you.

lines.zh: 你的马身靠着我的马身。
lines.en: Your horse body leans against mine.

lines.zh: 我的马尾扫过草地，很响。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the grass, loud.
I put my quiver in your hands.

lines.zh: 马身那片鬃毛，听见了吗。
lines.en: Did you hear the mane rustle?
You smell like home.
Half human, half horse — company is hard to find.

lines.zh: 这片草原上，只有我们两匹马。
lines.en: Only our two horses on this plain.

lines.zh: 他们看见我们，会把门关上。
lines.en: They'll shut their doors when they see us.

lines.zh: 草原上，我的箭袋还满着。
lines.en: On the plains, my quiver is still full.
Found it near claws.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进腰间的皮袋。
lines.en: I stuff it into the pouch at my waist.
My quiver is still heavy.
What falls on the plain is mine.
A fine blade. I'll keep it.
I keep the iron nuggets for arrowheads.
I hang this quiver behind my saddle.

lines.zh: 这顶铁盔，扣得上我的头。
lines.en: This iron helm fits my head.

lines.zh: 地上这点东西，归先到的。
lines.en: Whatever lies here belongs to whoever came first.

lines.zh: 这卷皮革，正好补我的鞍。
lines.en: This rolled leather will patch my saddle.
My arrows carry poison.
Better me than someone else. Less searching.

lines.zh: 我先射一箭，毒在箭头上。
lines.en: I loose first, poison on the head.
Finally, something alive.
My tail sweeps a tuft of grass aside.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁锈味，太明显。
lines.en: Your rust smell gives you away.

lines.zh: 四个人蹄印，围住你一个。
lines.en: Four hoofprints close around your one.

lines.zh: 就是你，站在草最稀的那块。
lines.en: You, standing where the grass thins.
I back half a step to give the arrow room.

lines.zh: 我朝身后的马群低吼一声。
lines.en: I growl back at the herd behind me.
I nock the arrow; my hand is steady.

lines.zh: 你的鼓点，我一箭就能停。
lines.en: One arrow can stop that drumbeat.
Four legs cover ground faster than you.

lines.zh: 弓弦一响，我的箭已经出。
lines.en: The string sings; my arrow is already gone.

lines.zh: 我这四条腿，跑起来不慢。
lines.en: These four legs aren't slow.

lines.zh: 你的护甲缝，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: I see the seams in your armor clearly.

lines.zh: 我换了条小路，从侧面来。
lines.en: I take a side path and come in from the flank.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱得像被追的鹿。
lines.en: You breathe like a hunted deer.
How much running is left in you?

lines.zh: 这片草原，我天天用蹄子量。
lines.en: I measure this plain with my hooves daily.

lines.zh: 只剩四分之一血，我先跑。
lines.en: A quarter health left — I run first.

lines.zh: 你拐进林子，我从树间穿过去。
lines.en: You turn into the woods; I cut between the trees.

lines.zh: 草被压过的方向，就是你走的路。
lines.en: The flattened grass points where you went.
Footsteps stopped? Then we close in.
I draw and wait for your head to show.

lines.zh: 你上了坡，我就绕到坡下。
lines.en: Climb, and I'll circle to the foot of the slope.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子能踹开这扇门。
lines.en: My hooves can kick this door in.

lines.zh: 风把你的汗吹到我这边。
lines.en: The wind brings your sweat to me.

lines.zh: 我的箭头上还抹着虚弱的汁。
lines.en: The weakness sap is still wet on my arrowhead.

lines.zh: 你敢射我一箭，马群都会冲上来。
lines.en: One arrow and the herd charges.

lines.zh: 夜里我的眼睛比白天好。
lines.en: My eyes are better at night than by day.

lines.zh: 我四蹄一错，就截在你前面。
lines.en: A shift of four hooves puts me ahead of you.
That bundle dropped at your feet.

lines.zh: 我半身是马，跑起来不喘。
lines.en: I'm half horse; I don't tire running.

lines.zh: 你的鞋底在碎石上打滑。
lines.en: Your soles slip on the gravel.
My bow is already drawn.
My arrows carry venom and weakness.

lines.zh: 我把弓横过来，抽你脖子。
lines.en: I swing the bow sideways at your neck.

lines.zh: 我一边奔跑，一边转身放箭。
lines.en: I loose a shot while turning at a run.
The bow on my back isn't drawn yet.
This arrow carries poison and weakness.
My forelegs rear, then come down.

lines.zh: 这一箭贴着你耳朵过去。
lines.en: This arrow skims past your ear.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子踏在你脚边，很响。
lines.en: My hoof stamps beside your foot, loud.
Four hooves, and I run like wind.
My arrow splits your shield strap.
One stamp of my hooves and the ground rings.

lines.zh: 毒在血里散开，你的手会软。
lines.en: The poison spreads; your hands will weaken.

lines.zh: 箭从你护颈的缝里进去。
lines.en: The arrow enters at your gorget's gap.

lines.zh: 倒吧，别撑着，毒箭已经上弦。
lines.en: Fall; the poison arrow is nocked.

lines.zh: 我贴近你，弓抵着你的胸。
lines.en: I close in, bow against your chest.

lines.zh: 人手的力道加上马身的冲劲。
lines.en: Human arm and horse momentum together.

lines.zh: 四分之一血，我先跑开回气。
lines.en: At a quarter health I break off to heal.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子踩下去，草都断了。
lines.en: My hooves come down and the grass breaks.

lines.zh: 我一只手按住你，另一只拉弦。
lines.en: One hand pins you, the other draws.

lines.zh: 我的箭头在你肩上断了一截。
lines.en: My arrowhead snaps off in your shoulder.
My hooves halt at the treeline.

lines.zh: 从土里爬出来，满身沙子。
lines.en: Up from the dirt, covered in sand.
Wounded, I run.
I take the bow down from my back.
I shake my horse head and straighten up.
Four hooves land — clear the road.
I push myself up out of the grass.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子踩碎了一地枯枝。
lines.en: My hooves snap the dry twigs underfoot.
Night's here — hooves can run free.

lines.zh: 我先看看有没有人跟来。
lines.en: First I check whether anyone followed.

lines.zh: 草的味不对，不是我熟的地。
lines.en: The grass smells wrong; this isn't my ground.

lines.zh: 马蹄一响，林子里就听见了。
lines.en: One hoofbeat and the whole wood hears.
Flame climbs my mane.
Four hooves are steadier on hills.
Water covers my horse back; I keep kicking.

lines.zh: 炸起的土打在我的马腹上。
lines.en: Blown dirt stings my horse belly.

lines.zh: 那支箭扎在我的马臀上。
lines.en: That arrow is stuck in my horse's rump.
Magic burned me — my hooves go soft.
This time I really need to graze.
Lightning hit the plain. I bolted.

lines.zh: 没有地面，我的四蹄乱蹬。
lines.en: No ground; my four hooves flail.
